"arch_module", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "_t17"."seq" ASC, "_t17"."id" ASC) AS "ord", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "arity" FROM "anchors" AS "_t17" INNER JOIN "anchors" AS "_t18" ON (("_t18"."id" = (CASE WHEN ("_t17"."src" = "_t11"."origin_id") THEN "_t17"."dst" ELSE "_t17"."src" END)) AND ("_t18"."kind" = CAST($72 AS text)) AND ((CAST($73 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t18"."arch_type" = CAST($73 AS text)) OR ("_t18"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t19"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t19" WHERE ("_t19"."ancestor" = CAST($73 AS text))))) AND (("_t18"."root_id" = CAST($15 AS uuid)) OR (CAST((("_t18"."props" -> CAST($74 AS text)) ->> CAST($75 AS text)) AS bigint) > CAST($76 AS bigint)) OR (((("_t18"."props" -> CAST($74 AS text)) -> CAST($77 AS text)) -> CAST($78 AS text)) ? CAST($21 AS text)) OR EXISTS (SELECT CAST($79 AS bigint) AS "one" FROM "anchors" AS "_t20" WHERE (("_t20"."kind" = CAST($80 AS text)) AND ("_t20"."src" = CAST($15 AS uuid)) AND (((("_t18"."props" -> CAST($74 AS text)) -> CAST($81 AS text)) -> CAST($82 AS text)) ? CAST("_t20"."dst" AS text)))))) WHERE ((("_t17"."kind" = CAST($83 AS text)) AND (("_t17"."src" = "_t11"."origin_id") OR ("_t17"."undirected" AND ("_t17"."dst" = "_t11"."origin_id"))) AND ((CAST($84 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t17"."arch_type" = CAST($84 AS text)) OR ("_t17"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t21"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t21" WHERE ("_t21"."ancestor" = CAST($84 AS text)))))))) AS "_t16" WHERE COALESCE((((("_t13"."props" -> CAST($61 AS text)) ->> CAST($67 AS text)) = CAST($68 AS text))), CAST($69 AS boolean))) AS "_t14" ON CAST($85 AS boolean) WHERE (("_t11"."phase" = CAST($86 AS bigint)) AND ("_t13"."id" = "_t11"."origin_id") AND ("_t13"."kind" = CAST($87 AS text)) AND ("_t13"."arch_type" = CAST($88 AS text)) AND ("_t13"."arch_module" = CAST($89 AS text)))) AS "_t12") AS "_union_r") AS "_set" ("slot", "depth", "origin_id", "target_id", "edge_id", "arch_type", "arch_module", "ord", "arity", "valid", "enabled", "cycle", "next_phase") ORDER BY "depth" ASC, "ord" ASC LIMIT CAST($90 AS bigint)
DISCARD ALL

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
DISCARD ALL

definitions.HTTP_response: Existing instrumented client HTTP end minus start; excludes explicit post-response drain.
definitions.HTTP_span: First workflow HTTP start to last HTTP end; includes between-request work/gaps.
definitions.with_drain_span: First workflow HTTP start to last explicit drain end, includes gaps; not sum DB or pure server/CPU.
